description: Runs the free Portfolio Optimizer Pro checkup on a list of holdings and weights. Returns the A+ to F structural grade, the 0-100 score, any structural ceiling (cap) applied, each factor's sub-score with its measured fact, the top findings that held the grade down, the price-history dates used, a disclaimer and full_breakdown_url, a link that opens the same graded checkup on the website. Grades describe diversification, cost and past risk; they are educational, not advice or a forecast. Unknown tickers are listed in unknown_tickers, never guessed.

holdings.description: The portfolio: 1 to 30 holdings, each ticker once, with its weight.

ticker.description: Fund or company ticker symbol as listed on a US exchange, e.g. "VTI".

weight.description: Share of the portfolio. Percent (60 = 60%) or fraction (0.6); weights are normalized to total 100%.

name: grade_portfolio

binding.description: True when the score would have been higher without this ceiling.

cap_applied.description: Lowest structural ceiling that applies, or null.

full_breakdown_url.description: Opens the free checkup already graded for these holdings, with the full explanation.

grade.description: Letter grade A+ to F, or "Not graded".

top_findings.description: Top 1–3 things that held the grade down.

unknown_tickers.description: Tickers with no usable price history; they were left out and the grade is capped as partial.

title: Grade a portfolio
